title: I wont be in a place to pay my LRA dues until I teach some summer classes. If folks see any interesting #literacies or #lra18 emails on listserv pleas
summary: I wont be in a place to pay my LRA dues until I teach some summer classes. If folks see any interesting #literacies or #lra18 emails on listserv please forward to me. I still argue LRA should move to a "member recruitment" model and not a "member benefit" model. We should allow everyone to see listserv.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I wont be in a place to pay my LRA dues until I teach some summer classes. If folks see any interesting #literacies or #lra18 emails on listserv please forward to me.

I still argue LRA should move to a "member recruitment" model and not a "member benefit" model.

We should allow everyone to see listserv.
